recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中細胞一片片排列，多為中大型母細胞：核卵圓或略不規則、染色質細緻、部分可見核仁，正常造血細胞明顯減少，符合急性白血病骨髓浸潤（本例為 MPAL）。
features: Sheets of intermediate-to-large blasts with loss of normal marrow architecture
Oval to irregular nuclei with fine, dispersed chromatin
Small but visible nucleoli in a subset of cells
Moderate pale eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders
Few residual small dark erythroid or lymphoid cells; overall cellularity not assessable at this magnification
describe_en: High-power view of the H&E-stained bone marrow biopsy shows sheets of intermediate to large blasts with oval to irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, occasional small nucleoli and moderate pale cytoplasm. Residual normal hematopoietic elements are sparse. Overall cellularity cannot be judged at this magnification. The findings indicate extensive marrow involvement by acute leukemia, and lineage assignment as mixed phenotype acute leukemia requires flow cytometry or immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Morphology is indistinguishable, and immunophenotyping must show absence of a second lineage.
Lymphoblasts are TdT-positive with CD19/PAX5 or CD3 without MPO, which requires IHC or flow.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Non-hematopoietic tumors form cohesive nests, are CD45 negative and express markers such as synaptophysin, desmin or keratin.
DLBCL cells are larger with vesicular chromatin and CD20/PAX5 positivity, lacking CD34 and TdT.
